name: Young Company
situation: Client landing pages were losing mobile visitors before the page finished loading.
obstacle: The creative direction was the product, so speed could not come out of the design.
decision: Built Google AMP landing pages and tuned the existing PHP and MySQL stack for performance and search.
result: Award-winning mobile experiences that kept the design intent intact.
visualAlt: Screenshot of youngcompany.com, the marketing agency whose client landing pages and AMP work this covers.
